Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface EvaluationCycleService

All Known Implementing Classes:
EvaluationCycleServiceImpl
public interface EvaluationCycleService
Service interface for evaluation cycle management operations. This interface defines the contract for managing the complete lifecycle of evaluation cycles including creation, activation, closure, and user notification workflows.

Key evaluation cycle services include:

  • Cycle Creation: Starting new evaluation periods with date validation
  • Bulk Evaluation Generation: Creating evaluations for all managed users
  • Cycle Management: Retrieving active and historical evaluation cycles
  • Notification Workflows: Email notifications for cycle events and closures
  • Validation Controls: Ensuring all users have managers before starting cycles
  • Integration Support: Asynchronous email service integration

This service ensures proper evaluation cycle management by validating organizational readiness, creating comprehensive evaluation coverage, and managing the complete cycle workflow.

  • Method Details

    • startCycle

      void startCycle(Long adminId, DateRange dateRange)
      Starts a new evaluation cycle for the specified date range. Validates that all users have assigned managers, creates the evaluation cycle, generates evaluations for all eligible users, and sends notification emails.
      Parameters:
      adminId - the ID of the admin user starting the evaluation cycle
      dateRange - the date range defining the evaluation period

    • getActiveCycle

      EvaluationCycleDTO getActiveCycle(Long requesterId)
      Retrieves the currently active evaluation cycle. Returns the evaluation cycle that is currently in progress.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user requesting the active cycle information
      Returns:
      EvaluationCycleDTO representing the active cycle, or null if no active cycle

    • getAllCycles

      List<EvaluationCycleDTO> getAllCycles(Long requesterId, boolean active)
      Retrieves evaluation cycles based on their active status. Can return either active cycles only or all historical cycles.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user requesting cycle information
      active - true to retrieve only active cycles, false to retrieve all cycles
      Returns:
      list of EvaluationCycleDTO objects matching the active status criteria

    • checkAndCloseEvaluationCycle

      void checkAndCloseEvaluationCycle(Long evaluationCycleId)
      Checks if an evaluation cycle should be closed based on the completion status of its evaluations. A cycle is closed when all evaluations within it are either completed or closed. When a cycle is closed, its status is updated and closure notifications are sent.
      Parameters:
      evaluationCycleId - the ID of the evaluation cycle to check

    • checkAndCompleteEvaluationCycle

      void checkAndCompleteEvaluationCycle(Long evaluationCycleId)
      Checks if an evaluation cycle should be marked as completed based on the status of its evaluations. A cycle is marked as completed when there are no ongoing evaluations. When a cycle is completed, notifications are sent to the admin responsible for the cycle.
      Parameters:
      evaluationCycleId - the ID of the evaluation cycle to check
